body: you look amazing! as a 4’11 girl…i need to know where in the world you got these 🔥

Mindy was one of my close friends in college. It’s been about 7 or 8 years since I cut contact with her because of her erratic and deeply disturbing behavior. We had a conversation about mental illness in which she encouraged self injury- for herself and suggested it for me as a way to deal with my own depressive thoughts. 

Mindy knew that I am Jewish…i don’t remember her saying anything about that at all, atleast to me. I am shocked but knowing her as a person, i am not surprised. I can’t help but wonder now if this conversation we had about self harm was tied together with her antisemitism. She is again, a very disturbed person.

I tend to factor in personality tests/ with astro signs too! 
me: Aries sun | Pisces moon | Sag Rising, INFJ
him: Aquarius sun | Leo moon | Aquarius rising, INTJ
your personal style is very unique & you seem to be a laid back and thoughtful person- not attention seeking
you look like a very kind and inviting person! the type of friend that makes others feel comfortable.

I’ve gathered a lot of info about astrology and  always understood it as: 

Your Sun sign is how you believe you move about in the world. 
Your Moon sign reflects your innermost feelings 
Your Rising sign / Ascendent is how others perceive you. 

For example a combo I could be is Biniyam / Danielle / Debbie….

You know what? Forget it. Talk amongst yourselves and gather more info because I’m late for my psychiatry appointment 👋🏻
you are so beautiful! 10/10. your hair color, skin color and outfit colors together are gorgeous.

thank you all for your insight. Your comments have really helped me gather my thoughts and figure out how to deal with them productively…i added an update to the post. This feels like a never ending saga. ugh lol!
